original.reason: The proposed intervals have endpoints incremented by 1/(b-a), rather than (b-a)/N. They need not cover E and their lengths are unrelated to the chosen N, so the asserted existence of a representative within delta is unjustified.

judgment.reason: A finite partition of a containing interval into subintervals of length less than delta, followed by a representative-point argument, correctly proves boundedness.
The finite equal-interval cover and selected representatives give a uniform bound 1+C on f.
The proof correctly constructs finitely many delta-small intervals and derives the bound from uniform continuity.
The partition has mesh below delta and the triangle inequality yields the stated finite bound.
